from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os

import platform
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import tomllib

ROOT = Path('/tmp/stele-control-profile')
OUT = Path('/tmp/stele-controls-profile-bc1830f')
HEAD = 'bc1830ffa91b92241b288c1ac4c04bb492a1ce10'
TREE = 'e70205d7392f973fa56a884c56609d387dbd7374'

def stamp():
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def read_command(args):
    return subprocess.check_output(args, cwd=ROOT, text=True).strip()

def source_check():
    assert read_command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == HEAD
    assert read_command(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}']) == TREE
    assert not read_command(['git', 'status', '--porcelain'])

source_check()
overrides = [k for k, v in os.environ.items() if v and (
    k.startswith('CARGO_PROFILE_') or k in {
        'RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_ENCODED_RUSTFLAGS', 'CARGO_BUILD_RUSTFLAGS',
        'RUSTC_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER', 'RUSTC', 'CARGO_BUILD_TARGET'})]
assert not overrides, ('Unexpected compiler override names', overrides)
config = tomllib.loads((ROOT / 'Cargo.toml').read_text())
assert config['profile']['test'] == {
    'opt-level': 2, 'debug-assertions': True, 'overflow-checks': True}
assert 'dev' not in config['profile']
OUT.mkdir()
source_paths = ['Cargo.toml', 'Cargo.lock', 'rust-toolchain.toml',
    'tests/negative-controls/Cargo.toml', 'tests/negative-controls/catalog.md',
    'tests/negative-controls/src/main.rs', 'tests/negative-controls/src/lib.rs',
    'tests/negative-controls/src/catalog.rs']
source_pins = {p: sha(ROOT / p) for p in source_paths}
plan = dict(task='E0-09', source_commit=HEAD, source_tree=TREE,
    source_sha256=source_pins, order=['dev', 'test'], repetitions=1,
    build='Separate empty target directories; actual normal binary, locked/offline.',
    execution='One direct --coverage execution per profile; build and execution are disjoint.',
    invalid_arguments=[[], ['unexpected'], ['--coverage', 'extra']],
    expected=dict(rows=104, proof_controls=50, configuration_controls=1,
        missing_controls=53, named_bindings=17, catalog_bindings=32),
    qualifications=['Shared host; original workers retained and not inspected or manipulated.',
        'One ordered screening pair; no statistical, whole-CI or inference speedup claim.',
        'No warm Cargo execution or duplicate coverage sample is hidden in this pair.',
        'Commit/tree plus clean-source checks identify the complete repository source.'],
    controller_sha256=sha(Path(__file__)), started_at=stamp())
(OUT / 'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
results = dict(plan=plan, python=sys.version, host=platform.platform(),
    cpu=read_command(['sysctl', '-n', 'machdep.cpu.brand_string']),
    rustc=read_command(['rustc', '--version', '--verbose']),
    cargo=read_command(['cargo', '--version']), configurations=[], complete=False)

def save():
    (OUT / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')

def run(label, argv, env):
    stdout, stderr = OUT / (label + '.stdout'), OUT / (label + '.stderr')
    record = dict(label=label, argv=argv, cwd=str(ROOT), started_at=stamp(),
        load_before=[str(x) for x in os.getloadavg()])
    print(json.dumps({'start': label}), flush=True)
    start = time.monotonic_ns()
    with stdout.open('xb') as out, stderr.open('xb') as err:
        completed = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    record.update(wall_ns=time.monotonic_ns() - start, exit_code=completed.returncode,
        ended_at=stamp(), load_after=[str(x) for x in os.getloadavg()],
        stdout=str(stdout), stdout_sha256=sha(stdout), stdout_bytes=stdout.stat().st_size,
        stderr=str(stderr), stderr_sha256=sha(stderr), stderr_bytes=stderr.stat().st_size)
    print(json.dumps({'finish': label, 'exit_code': record['exit_code'],
        'wall_ns': record['wall_ns']}), flush=True)
    return record

save()
reports, invalid_results, runtime_graphs = [], [], []
for profile, level in [('dev', '0'), ('test', '2')]:
    target = OUT / ('target-' + profile)
    target.mkdir()
    overrides = {'CARGO_TARGET_DIR': str(target), 'CARGO_TERM_COLOR': 'never'}
    env = dict(os.environ, **overrides)
    item = dict(profile=profile, env=overrides)
    results['configurations'].append(item)
    command = ['cargo', 'build', '--profile', profile, '-p', 'stele-negative-controls',
        '--bin', 'stele-controls', '--locked', '--offline', '--verbose', '--message-format=json']
    item['build'] = run(profile + '-build', command, env)
    save()
    assert item['build']['exit_code'] == 0
    messages = [json.loads(line) for line in Path(item['build']['stdout']).read_text().splitlines()]
    assert any(m['reason'] == 'build-finished' and m['success'] for m in messages)
    artifacts = [m for m in messages if m['reason'] == 'compiler-artifact']
    selected = [m for m in artifacts if m['target']['name'] == 'stele-controls'
                and m['target']['kind'] == ['bin'] and m['executable']]
    assert len(selected) == 1
    artifact = selected[0]
    executable = Path(artifact['executable']).resolve()
    assert executable.is_relative_to(target.resolve()) and executable.is_file()
    item['artifact'] = artifact
    item['executable_sha256'] = sha(executable)
    runtime = [m for m in artifacts if m['target']['name'].startswith('stele_')
               or m['target']['name'] == 'stele-controls']
    assert len(runtime) >= 10
    for m in runtime:
        p = m['profile']
        assert p['opt_level'] == level and p['debug_assertions'] and p['overflow_checks']
        assert p['test'] is False
    graph = {m['target']['name']: sorted(m['features']) for m in runtime}
    assert len(graph) == len(runtime)
    runtime_graphs.append(graph)
    item['runtime_artifacts'] = [dict(name=m['target']['name'], features=m['features'],
                                    profile=m['profile']) for m in runtime]
    save()
    item['coverage'] = run(profile + '-coverage', [str(executable), '--coverage'], env)
    save()
    assert item['coverage']['exit_code'] == 0
    report = Path(item['coverage']['stdout']).read_bytes()
    assert Path(item['coverage']['stderr']).read_bytes() == b''
    reports.append(report)
    lines = report.decode().splitlines()
    rows = [line for line in lines if re.match(r'^NC-\d{4} \|', line)]
    statuses = Counter(line.rsplit('|', 1)[-1].strip() for line in rows)
    assert len(rows) == 104 and statuses == {'passed': 50, 'passed (configuration)': 1, 'MISSING': 53}
    assert lines.count('Catalog coverage: 17/32 bindings; 51/104 controls.') == 1
    assert lines.count('Configuration controls: 1 (not proof-statement coverage).') == 1
    item['invalid_arguments'] = []
    invalid = []
    for index, args in enumerate(plan['invalid_arguments']):
        check = run(f'{profile}-invalid-{index}', [str(executable), *args], env)
        item['invalid_arguments'].append(check)
        save()
        out, err = Path(check['stdout']).read_bytes(), Path(check['stderr']).read_bytes()
        assert check['exit_code'] == 1 and out == b'' and err == b'usage: stele-controls --coverage\n'
        invalid.append((check['exit_code'], out, err))
    invalid_results.append(invalid)
    assert sha(executable) == item['executable_sha256']
    source_check()
    assert source_pins == {p: sha(ROOT / p) for p in source_paths}
assert reports[0] == reports[1] and invalid_results[0] == invalid_results[1]
assert runtime_graphs[0] == runtime_graphs[1]
results.update(complete=True, ended_at=stamp(), coverage_sha256=hashlib.sha256(reports[0]).hexdigest(),
    safety_and_features_equal=True, exact_coverage_output_equal=True)
save()
print(json.dumps({'complete': True, 'receipt': str(OUT / 'results.json'),
    'sha256': sha(OUT / 'results.json')}), flush=True)
